description: Update the camera credentials for the 'Entrance Camera' in the Nx Witness VMS system via the Web Admin interface at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin/Admin1234!). Navigate to the Cameras section, select the 'Entrance Camera', click the 'Edit Credentials' button in the Authentication section, and set the camera login to username 'camuser' and password 'Cam@SecurePass2024'. Save the changes. Verify the credentials were updated by checking that the camera still appears in the list.
